# Trebell Code

> Trebell Code is Trebell's flagship open-source desktop AI software-engineering product.

## Product

- Trebell Code: https://code.trebell.dev/
- Source repository: https://github.com/tanishqbaweja/trebellcode

- License: Apache-2.0
- Current shipped desktop release: v1.3.6

## What it does

Trebell Code provides an agent runtime/harness around coding models: repository context, deterministic tools, terminal and file operations, Git/worktrees, browser verification, durable state, recovery, permissions, caching/context management, telemetry, and evidence-based completion.

## Intended users

Trebell Code is built for software developers and engineering teams using AI coding agents on real codebases, especially where provider choice, reproducible execution, verification, and cost visibility matter.

## Business model

The desktop harness is open source for developers. Trebell plans a paid team infrastructure layer with shared policy, usage and cost controls, managed execution environments, auditability, and administration.

## Benchmarks

The site reports same-model comparisons against other coding harnesses. Treat each claim together with its named task, verifier result, model/reasoning settings, and cost/token measurements rather than as a universal model-quality claim.
